harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «والذين كفروا......» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause «هذا هدى»; the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين»; the preposition «من رجز» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «الله الذي»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The preposition «بأمره» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الفلك»; the preposition «فيه» is attached to «تجري»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «ولتبتغوا» is genitive (majrūr), conjoined to the first genitive maṣdar «لتجري»; and the clause «ولعلكم تشكرون» is conjoined to the single-word genitive maṣdar «ولتبتغوا».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما»; the preposition «منه» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «جميعا»; and the clause «يتفكرون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) is implied (muqaddar), i.e. "forgive", meaning: if you tell them, they will forgive — those meant being the believers, who comply whenever he commands them. The clause «يغفروا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليجزي» is genitive (majrūr) and attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قل», and the preposition «بما» is attached to «يجزي».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «مَنْ»: conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); «صالحًا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). His words «فلنفسه»: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then his deed is for himself"; the implied form of the second apodosis (jawāb) is "then his evil-doing is against himself". The clause «ترجعون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «مَنْ عَمِل».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The preposition «على العالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فضَّلْناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «بينات»: second object; the preposition «من الأمر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بينات». The clause «فما اختلفوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «آتيناهم»; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition «من بعد» is attached to «اختلفوا»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «بغيا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); «بينهم» is an adverb attached to a naʿt of «بغيا». The two adverbs «بينهم» and «يوم» are attached to «يقضي», as is «فيما»; and the preposition «فيه» is attached to «يختلفون».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «ثم» is a particle of resumption, and the clause after it is resumptive. The preposition «على شريعة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل», and the clause «فاتبعها» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «جعلناك».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The preposition «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيئا»; «شيئا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a little or a great sufficing". The clause «وإن الظالمين ... » is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «إنهم لن يغنوا», and the clause «بعضهم أولياء» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The preposition «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بصائر»; the preposition «لقوم» is attached to a naʿt of «رحمة».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «أم» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن نجعلهم» stands in place of the two objects of «حَسِبَ»; the preposition «كالذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «نجعل». «سواء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the preposition «كالذين», i.e. "they being equal"; «محياهم» is the fāʿil (agent) of «سواء». The clause «ساء ما يحكمون» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil of «ساء», and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "their judgement".

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «وخلق» is resumptive; the preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خلق». His words «ولتجزى»: the wāw is conjunctive, and the genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to something implied, i.e. "so that it may point to His power and so that … may be recompensed". The clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is a ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «أفرأيت» is resumptive; it means "tell me" and takes two objects: the first is «مَنْ», a relative noun, and the second is a clause implied after «غشاوة», i.e. "will he be guided?". «اتخذ» takes two objects: «إلهه هواه». The preposition «على علم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Name of Majesty, and the preposition «على بصره» is attached to the second object. The clause «فمن يهديه» is resumptive, as is the clause «تَذَكَّرون».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «وقالوا» is resumptive; «هي ... حياتنا»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The clause «نموت» is resumptive, and the clause «وما يهلكنا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «نموت». The clause «وما لهم علم» is resumptive; «علم» is the mubtadaʾ and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «بذلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «عِلْم». The clause «إن هم إلا يظنون» is resumptive, and «إن» is negative.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb), not to its apodosis «ما كان», because what follows «ما» does not govern what precedes it. «إذا» differs from the conditional particles in that the fāʾ is not joined to its apodosis when that is negated with «ما», unlike the others, with which the fāʾ is required, as in: «إن تزرنا فما جفوتنا» (if you visit us, then you have not been distant from us). «بينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آياتنا»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن قالوا» is the noun (ism) of «كان», and «حجتهم» is the khabar of «كان». The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «لا ريب فيه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «يوم القيامة», and the clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause of the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «ولله ملك» is resumptive. His words «ويوم»: the wāw is conjunctive; «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يخسر», and the clause «يخسر» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause «لله ملك». «يومئذ» is a badal (substitute) from «يوم تقوم»; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and its tanwīn is the tanwīn of compensation for an implied clause.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «وترى» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {يَخْسَرُ}; «جاثية» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «كل أمة», which is specified by the annexation, and the seeing is visual. «كل» is mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause «تُدْعَى» is the khabar (predicate). «اليوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تجزون»; the clause «تجزون» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of an implied saying; «ما» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «هذا كتابنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the clause «ينطق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «كتابنا»; and the clause «إنَّا كنَّا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «أمَّا» is a particle of condition and detailing. The clause «فأما الذين....» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {هَذَا كِتَابُنَا}; the fāʾ in «فيدخلهم» is connective (rābiṭa), and the clause is the khabar (predicate). The preposition «في رحمته» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يدخلهم», and «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «أفلم تكن آياتي» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of an implied saying, i.e. "then Allah will say to them: were not …"; the clause «فيقول الله» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين كفروا»; and the clause «فاستكبرتم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «أفلم تكن آياتي».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The conditional clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «كنتم». The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is a pronoun referring to its maṣdar (verbal noun). The clause «والساعة لا ريب فيها» is conjoined to the clause «إن وعد الله حق», and the clause «لا ريب فيها» is the khabar (predicate) of «الساعة». The clause «ما ندري» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying), and the clause «ما الساعة» stands in place of the two objects of «ندري», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. The clause «إن نظن» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; «ظناً» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «وما نحن بمستيقنين» is conjoined to the clause «إنْ نظن», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar of «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «وبدا لهم» is resumptive; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun of the maṣdar (verbal noun). «اليوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ننساكم»; the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "We forget you with a forgetting like your forgetting". «هذا» is a naʿt (adjective); it is a non-derived noun interpreted as a derived one, i.e. "the one pointed to". The clause «ومأواكم النار» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «ننساكم», and the clause «وما لكم من ناصرين» is conjoined to the clause «مأواكم النار»; «ناصرين» is mubtadaʾ (subject) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from «أنَّ» and what follows it is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «ذلكم». «هزوا» is the second object. The clause «وغَرَّتكم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «اتخذتم». The fāʾ in «فاليوم» is resumptive; the clause «لا يُخْرَجون» is resumptive, and the clause «ولا هم يُستعتبون» is conjoined to the clause «لا يُخرجون».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «فلله الحمد» is resumptive; the second «رب» is a badal (substitute), and the third «رب» is a badal from the second.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «وله الكبرياء» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ}; the preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكبرياء»; and the clause «وهو العزيز» is conjoined to the clause «له الكبرياء».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «تنزيل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate); «الحكيم» is a second naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «للمؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «وفي خلقكم ... آيات» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إن في السماوات ... لآيات»; «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «خَلْقكم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من دابة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «آيات» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun «لقوم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات»; and the clause «يوقنون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: His saying «واختلاف»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to {خَلْقِكُمْ}; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, by conjunction to «اختلاف»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أَنزل»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من رزق» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «آيات» is a noun conjoined to «آيات» in the previous verse. This is a case of conjunction to [the objects of] two governors, and it is permissible: that is, «اختلاف» is conjoined to {خَلْقِكُمْ}, which is governed by «في», and the second «آيات» is conjoined to the first «آيات», which is governed by inception (al-ibtidāʾ).

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «نتلوها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آيات»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «نتلو»; and the clause «يؤمنون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نتلوها عليك بالحق».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «ويل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun «لكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «يسمع» is a naʿt (adjective) of {أَفَّاكٍ}; the clause «تتلى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آيات»; «مستكبرا» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يصرُّ»; «كأن» is lightened from the heavy one, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause «لم يسمعها» is the khabar (predicate) of «كأن»; the clause «كأن لم يسمعها» is a second ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يصرُّ»; and the clause «فبشِّره» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا}; the preposition and its genitive noun «من آياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «شيئا»; «هزوا» is a second object; the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك», and the clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «من ورائهم جهنم» is a second khabar (predicate) of {أُولَئِكَ}; the clause «ولا يغني عنهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «من ورائهم جهنم»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of «يغني», i.e.: and their earning will not avail them «شيئاً», [which is] a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the second «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar «ما اتخذوا» is conjoined to the first maṣdar, the implied form being: and neither their earning nor their taking will avail them. The preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أولياء»; and the clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause {لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ} in verse (9).
